The union of the Who's On First region records Monaghan (85685117), Cavan (85685125), Donegal (85685151). A record is assigned to the first-level division GeoNames files the populated places inside its boundary under. For each of the 26 records, at least 99 percent of those places are under one division. The boundary is the three counties of Ulster in Ireland. The other six counties of Ulster are in Northern Ireland, in the GB repository.
